text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, I spotted two girls 
making quite a commotion.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mirako-o-o-o~~! I got stuck with a makeup 
exam! Save me-e-e-e!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~?! Save you? But it's not like I can 
teach you how to study~.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I know that! Our grades are basically neck 
and neck, after all!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Which is why we'll make a "gamble"! Pick 
where you think the questions will come 
from for me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wait, why me?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Just pick already! Come on!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~? Fine, I'll just pick randomly~... 
Here, here, and here~~~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, seriously, what a waste of time... 
Always, always doing this... *snort*...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm... you know, that girl just now. 
That's No Reason-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whenever something happens, she comes 
straight to bug me. Going, "Mirako-o~! Is 
Mirako there~?!"
choice_data_list: It's nice that you're so close.
It's great that you're such good friends.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, does it look that way? Well~, I 
guess that might be true~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No Reason-chan and I are in the same 
class~, and when the new term started, our 
seats were close. You know, our attendance 
numbers are close too with "No" and "Hi".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So we ended up in the same groups and 
duties. Somehow we just started hanging 
out together a lot...
choice_data_list:
So you're like inseparable buddies, 
huh...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah~, exactly! That's pretty much it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even so, having such an intense girl get 
along so well with someone as totally 
average as me is kind of a mystery~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few days later. I saw the two of them 
on campus once again.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hooray!! The makeup exam has been 
vanquished~~!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Gwahaha! Pulling all-nighters studying 
because I believed in you was totally 
worth it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, congrats~. That was totally thanks to 
me, wasn't it? For my reward, extra-extra 
honey topping will do nicely♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, gladly! Let me treat you by all 
means! Put ice cream on it too! You were a 
real lifesaver, after all~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, no, I was just kidding! I didn't 
actually do anything!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying?! It was entirely 
thanks to you! Just as I expected of 
you...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—When push comes to shove, you're the kind 
of girl who pulls off miracles!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether it was truly thanks to Hishi 
Miracle... was honestly hard to tell, but 
No Reason firmly believed it was.
choice_data_list: You really believe in Hishi Miracle, huh?

You really have faith in Hishi Miracle, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether it was truly thanks to Hishi 
Miracle... was honestly hard to tell, but 
No Reason firmly believed it was.
choice_data_list: You really believe in Hishi Miracle, huh?

You really have faith in Hishi Miracle, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm not amazing at all~! No Reason-chan is 
just making things up~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
No way, Mirako is no ordinary girl! She 
might look average, but she's 
extraordinary!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Nah~, I think I'm totally normal~. 
Though...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"No ordinary girl"... huh? If that were 
really true, that'd be pretty cool~♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! This girl is going to make it big 
someday! It's best to stay on her good 
side while I still can!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way... Flattery won't get you a 
peek at tomorrow's homework~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well... it doesn't feel bad to hear, 
though. Ehehe...
